description: This file defines the RangeQueryProvider class which implements ILuceneQueryProvider. It creates Lucene range queries based on JSON input, supporting numeric and string ranges with optional boost parameters.

classes.name: RangeQueryProvider
classes.description: Provides Lucene range queries based on JSON input, supporting numeric and string ranges with optional boost.

methods.name: CreateQuery
methods.description: Creates a Lucene range query from JSON parameters, supporting 'gt', 'gte', 'lt', 'lte', and 'boost' options.
